exclude_overhire.note: Overhire, day-call and show-by-show crew work is EXCLUDED by default — it is not a career move and it drowns the inventory. THE EXCEPTION (Michael, 2026-09-10): if the work is within `home_base.accessible_radius_miles`, it QUALIFIES and gets rowed. Reasoning: near home, show-by-show work costs no relocation, needs no notice, and is availability income Michael can actually take. Far from home the same posting is noise. Rate is NOT the test and there is no floor on this exception — Michael, on SM work, 2026-09-02: 'open to far less esp if it's nearby.' Mark these rows `level=contract` and set `accessibility=home` so they can be filtered out of career-arc reporting without being hidden from the sweep.

home_base.note: Home base, and NOT a preference — geography stays 'anywhere' and relocation stays live. This block exists only to define what 'immediately accessible' MEANS so the overhire exception and the accessibility tiers are testable rather than vibes. 90 miles is a commutable same-day round trip and it deliberately reaches Syracuse (~87mi) and Buffalo (~75mi), which are the two nearest markets with real producing houses. ⚠ Ask Michael before widening this; do not quietly grow it to make a find qualify.

highlight_tiers.note: Added 2026-09-10 by Michael's ruling. These are REPORTING tiers, not filters — nothing is excluded for lacking a tier, and a row can hold more than one. Ricky tags rows; Corso surfaces them. Purpose: remote and near-home work is immediately actionable in a way a relocation-required role is not, and the standing inventory had no way to say so. ✅ Carried into the state files as the `accessibility` column on 2026-09-18; tags are pipe-separated when a row holds more than one.

tiers.remote: Posting explicitly states remote or fully-distributed. Never inferred from a job title — if the posting does not say it, the row does not get the tag. ⚠ Quote the words. A board's metadata card reading '(Remote)' over a body reading 'Work Location: In-office' is a live case from 2026-09-18 — the BODY wins and the tag is refused. Two more the same day advertised 'Remote' on a board card while the employer feed said Kansas City and Denver. ⚠ AND remote rarely means location-free: capture required states, travel and in-person obligations in the `location` field.
tiers.hybrid: Posting explicitly states hybrid or partial-remote, with a named onsite anchor. Same never-inferred rule as remote.
tiers.home: Within `home_base.accessible_radius_miles`. No relocation, no notice period. This is the ONE tier that may be derived rather than quoted, because it is arithmetic on a stated location.
tiers.immediate: Start date is now/ASAP/open-until-filled AND applications are accepted on a rolling basis with no deadline gate. This is about SPEED TO WORK, which is a different question from geography — keep the two tags separate and never collapse them.

highlight_tiers.reporting: The pass summary carries a ⚡ ACCESSIBLE block listing every row tagged remote / hybrid / home / immediate, sitting alongside ⚡ Spotlight. If the block is EMPTY, say so explicitly and say which sources were swept for it — an absent block and a swept-empty one are different facts, and conflating them is the single most-repeated failure in this routine.

remote_sweep.note: 🔴 The reason remote work never appears is NOT this config — `include_remote` has been true the whole time. It is that no keyword asks for it and every board in job-market-sources.md is venue-bound. Fixing it needed SOURCES, not a flag.
lanes_where_remote_is_plausible: drafting-design — the strongest candidate by far. CAD drafting, Vectorworks/Braceworks work and rigging documentation are routinely done off-site; the Upstaging Rigging Designer find (2026-09-09) is onsite but the DISCIPLINE is remote-friendly. ✅ CONFIRMED 2026-09-18: the remote work in this lane is EXPERIENTIAL, not theatrical — see job-market-sources-experiential.md. ⚠ BUT 2026-09-19 found the catch: the two genuine remote CAD employers (ASG, Compass/Waveguide) both demand AutoCAD, one of them 'mastery of AutoCAD and Revit'. The remote door in this lane is gated on the exact platform Michael deferred.

creative-admin — development, grants, marketing and company administration all have real remote markets. ✅ CONFIRMED AND SOURCED 2026-09-19: this is the most productive remote lane by a wide margin. Its barrier is TOOL FLUENCY (MailChimp, Canva, WordPress, Monday.com, donor databases, grants-management software), not certification.
producing-artistic — partially; literary and programming work travels, but producing generally does not.
lanes_where_remote_is_NOT_plausible: electrician, audio-sound, stage-manager — the work is physically in the room. Do not waste sweep budget hunting remote here, and do not report its absence as a finding. ✅ Re-confirmed by a swept search on 2026-09-19: this is a genuine market absence, not a source gap.

operations-safety — venue-bound by definition, though safety PLANNING and compliance documentation can be contracted remotely. Narrow exception, worth one probe. ⚪ PROBED 2026-09-18: returned nothing. Swept-empty, not unswept.
remote_sweep.owed: ✅ DISCHARGED 2026-09-19. Remote sources now exist at `routines/job-market-sources-remote.md` — ten routes opened and verified live, each with named roles and salaries as evidence, plus five recorded live-but-thin, four confirmed dead, and the mirror set flagged as pointers only. The parent job-market-sources.md points at it. 🔑 THE FINDING IS ASYMMETRIC AND IT SHOULD CHANGE HOW TWO LANES ARE SWEPT: remote creative-admin is a real, reusable, multi-board market that this routine had NEVER swept (it was unswept, not thin — best routes are Arts Admin Jobs, Philanthropy News Digest's provably-filtered 'Working from home' view, Idealist, AFP, Remote Impact); remote AV/CAD is genuine but SCARCE and gated on AutoCAD/Revit (best find: ASG's own Ashby ATS, CAD/Revit Mechanical Designer, $70-100k fully remote); and the physical lanes have no remote market at all. ⚠ Calibration: expect 3-8 qualifying remote rows per pass ACROSS ALL LANES, weighted to creative-admin. The 09-18 pass produced 7 remote + 6 hybrid against 338 rows, about 4%. If a pass suddenly returns thirty, suspect a mirror or an unfiltered result set before believing the market moved. ⭐ AND THE STANDING LESSON THIS FIELD ITSELF PROVED: a blocker is a CLAIM, and claims expire. This one said the directive 'cannot be executed properly' and was still being cited as current eight days later, when a single research pass closed it. Re-test a blocker before obeying it. 🔻 Lane seam, named not hidden: source discovery is Scout Sage's research lane per hooks/data-refresh.md; this was done by a research pass on Michael's explicit instruction.
